ModMetaData.name: Ideology Delete UI 1.5 v1.2
ModMetaData.author: Allen
ModMetaData.description:
One-click force deletion for ideoligions in an active RimWorld 1.5 save.
v1.2: deletion no longer blocks on faction or pawn references. Primary factions and believers are reassigned automatically, minor references are removed, active rituals are cancelled, stale baby exposure references are cleaned, and a fallback ideoligion is generated if deleting the last one. The selected ideoligion is then removed through vanilla IdeoManager.Remove().
